column1: # Copied from otfabric/iec60870-5-interop tests/iec102/known-bugs.tsv at v0.4.0 (contract 2.3).
# Known bugs of upstream versions for IEC 60870-5-102.
# Same columns and rules as tests/iec104/known-bugs.tsv: adapter, upstream
# version, a regular expression on the operation and its flags, what is wrong,
# an id, and a URL (the issue upstream, or the source line at the pinned
# commit). Every entry needs wire evidence from a run (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).
# None yet: gisce/iec870ree kept the contract in every run against the
# scripted meter (tests/iec102/meter.py), which is not an implementation of
# IEC 102, so this file says nothing about how gisce meets real meters.
